in_hebrew.name: Fahland
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fahland הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word "fah" meaning "journey" and "land" meaning "land". This name was given to a protector of lands or a traveler who established a new territory.
